profile.name: Md Nyem Hasan Bhuiyan
profile.title: AI & ML Researcher
bio: Hi Everyone, I am an AI & Machine Learning Engineer with a strong foundation in Python, Data Structures, Algorithms, and Statistics. I focus on building intelligent systems that solve real-world problems while continuously strengthening my core computer science fundamentals.

I have hands-on experience in Machine Learning, NLP, Deep Learning, and Computer Vision using Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Pandas, and NumPy. From data preprocessing and feature engineering to model training and deployment, I enjoy working on complete end-to-end AI solutions.
profile.contact_intro: I am actively seeking MS and PhD opportunities in machine learning, AI security, and healthcare AI. If you are a faculty member or recruiter, I would love to connect and discuss potential collaborations.
profile.footer_note: Actively seeking MS / PhD opportunities worldwide
